I can’t publish the page myself, but I can give you a polished, ready-to-paste pricing page and a clear deployment checklist so you or your dev can put it live today. If you want, I can also generate HTML/CMS-ready markup — tell me which CMS (Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, custom) and I’ll convert it.

Polished pricing-page copy (ready to paste)

Headline
Simple pricing that scales with your team

Subhead
Transparent plans, predictable billing — everything you need to get started and grow.

Pricing cards

Free
$0 / month
- Up to 2 users
- Core features
- Community support
Button: Get started — free

Pro
$29 / month (or $24/mo billed annually)
- Everything in Free, plus:
- Unlimited projects
- Advanced reporting & integrations
- Email support
Button: Start 14‑day trial

Business
$99 / month (or $79/mo billed annually)
- Everything in Pro, plus:
- SSO & advanced security
- SLA & priority support
- Onboarding and training
Button: Contact sales

Enterprise
Custom pricing
- Dedicated account team
- Custom integrations & deployment
- Compliance & advanced controls
Button: Request a demo

Why choose [Product]
- Fast setup — go from signup to value in under a day.
- Secure by design — enterprise-grade encryption and single sign-on.
- Proven ROI — reduce manual work and speed approvals.

Compare plans
(One-line summary table or bullets: which feature is in which plan — keep this section compact and easy to scan.)

Still not sure?
Get a personalized demo or chat with sales — button: Book a demo

Billing & FAQ (short)
- Payment methods: Credit card and invoice (Enterprise).
- Billing cycle: Monthly or annual (save 20% on annual).
- Cancellation: Cancel any time; data export included.
- Trial: 14-day free trial on Pro — no credit card required.
- Taxes and fees may apply; prices shown in USD.

Small print
Prices listed in USD. Additional fees may apply for add-ons and custom integrations. See full terms and privacy policy for details.

Deployment checklist (what to do to put this live today)
1. Finalize specifics
   - Replace [Product] and any placeholders (e.g., exact user limits, discounts).
   - Confirm currency, exact trial length, and refund policy text.

2. Create page assets
   - Copy/paste the content into your CMS page.
   - Add pricing-card images/icons and plan comparison table.
   - Set page title and meta description (example meta title: “[Product] Pricing — Simple plans for teams”; meta description: “Compare plans and pricing for [Product]. Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise options to fit every team.”)

3. Integrations & links
   - Ensure CTA buttons link to the correct signup, trial, or contact flows.
   - Connect billing provider (Stripe/Chargebee/others) and test checkout in staging.
   - Link to Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and support/contact pages.

4. QA & testing
   - Publish to staging and verify responsive layout on mobile/tablet/desktop.
   - Test CTAs, form submissions, and tracking pixels (Analytics, Segment).
   - Test coupons/annual pricing toggle and currency display if applicable.

5. Go-live
   - Clear caches / CDN purge.
   - Publish to production.
   - Smoke test checkout and CTA post-publish.

6. Post-publish ops
   - Notify Sales and Support with the live URL and any updated objection handling or playbook.
   - Confirm analytics events and conversion tracking are firing.
   - Monitor site and support queue for the first few hours for any issues.

Next steps — tell me which you want me to do now
- I’ll generate final HTML/CSS for this copy for a specific CMS — tell me which one.
- Or paste the existing signed-off draft and I’ll polish it to this style and produce an HTML snippet.
- Or I can just produce a final version with concrete numbers/placeholders replaced (e.g., currency, trial length) if you confirm those details.

Which option do you want?
